translations.literal: Advanced to Vice Minister of Personnel, transferred to Yingtian Prefecture, then changed to Henan Prefecture, advanced to Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance.
translations.idiomatic: He was advanced to Vice Minister of Personnel, transferred to Yingtian Prefecture, then reassigned to Henan Prefecture, and advanced to Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance.

sentences.zh: 陳安邊六事，又請於天雄軍聚甲兵以備河北，於永興軍、河中府益募土兵以備陝西，即涇原、環慶有警，河中援之。

translations.literal: He set forth six matters for securing the border, and also requested that armor and troops be gathered at Tianxiong Army to guard Hebei, that local militia be further recruited at Yongxing Army and Hezhong Prefecture to guard Shaanxi, and that if Jingyuan or Huanqing came under alarm, Hezhong would reinforce them.
translations.idiomatic: He presented six proposals for securing the frontier, and also asked that armor and troops be assembled at Tianxiong Army to defend Hebei, that local militia be further recruited at Yongxing Army and Hezhong Prefecture to defend Shaanxi, and that if Jingyuan or Huanqing came under attack, Hezhong would send reinforcements.

sentences.zh: 既而元昊反，拜振武軍節度使、知延州。

translations.literal: Before long Yuan Hao rebelled; [Yong] was appointed military governor of Zhenwu Army and prefect of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Yuan Hao rebelled, and Yong was appointed military governor of Zhenwu Army and prefect of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 因言：「延州最當賊衝，地闊而砦柵疏，近者百里，遠者二百里，土兵寡弱，又無宿將為用，而賊出入於此，請益師。」

translations.literal: He therefore said: "Yanzhou lies directly in the enemy's path; the territory is broad while stockades and palisades are sparse—some a hundred li apart, others two hundred li. Local militia are few and weak, and there are no seasoned generals to employ, yet the enemy moves in and out of this area. I request additional troops."
translations.idiomatic: He therefore said, "Yanzhou lies directly in the enemy's path. The territory is vast while stockades and palisades are widely spaced—some a hundred li apart, others two hundred. Local militia are few and weak, and there are no seasoned generals to command them, yet the enemy moves freely through this region. I request additional troops."

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: There was no response.
translations.idiomatic: The court did not reply.

sentences.zh: 元昊先遣人通款於雍，雍信之，不設備。

translations.literal: Yuan Hao first sent men to establish friendly relations with Yong; Yong believed them and made no preparations.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hao first sent envoys to open friendly relations with Yong; Yong trusted them and made no defensive preparations.

sentences.zh: 一日，引兵數萬破金明砦，乘勝至城下。

translations.literal: One day he led tens of thousands of troops to break Jinming stockade and, pressing the victory, reached the foot of the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: One day he led tens of thousands of troops to overrun Jinming stockade and, pressing his advantage, reached the foot of the city wall.

sentences.zh: 會大將石元孫領兵出境，守城者才數百人。

translations.literal: It happened that the great general Shi Yuansun was leading troops outside the border, and those defending the city numbered only a few hundred.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the senior general Shi Yuansun was leading troops beyond the border, and only a few hundred men remained to defend the city.

sentences.zh: 雍召劉平於慶州，平帥師來援，合元孫兵與賊夜戰三川口，大敗，平、元孫皆為賊所執。

translations.literal: Yong summoned Liu Ping from Qingzhou; Ping led troops to the rescue, combined with Yuansun's forces, and fought the enemy by night at Sanchuankou. They were badly defeated, and both Ping and Yuansun were captured by the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Yong summoned Liu Ping from Qingzhou; Ping led his army to the rescue, joined Yuansun's forces, and fought the enemy by night at Sanchuankou. They suffered a crushing defeat, and both Ping and Yuansun were captured.

sentences.zh: 雍閉門堅守，會夜大雪，賊解去，城得不陷。

translations.literal: Yong shut the gates and held firm; then heavy snow fell by night, the enemy withdrew, and the city was not lost.
translations.idiomatic: Yong shut the gates and held firm. That night heavy snow fell, the enemy withdrew, and the city was saved.

sentences.zh: 左遷戶部侍郎、知安州。

translations.literal: Demoted to Vice Minister of Revenue and prefect of Anzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to Vice Minister of Revenue and prefect of Anzhou.

sentences.zh: 居一歲，復吏部侍郎、知河中府。

translations.literal: After one year he was restored to Vice Minister of Personnel and prefect of Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After a year he was restored to Vice Minister of Personnel and made prefect of Hezhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 又為資政殿學士、知永興軍兼轉運司事，遷尚書左丞，加大學士。

translations.literal: Again made Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and military prefect of Yongxing while concurrently managing transport affairs, promoted to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, and additionally granted Grand Academician.
translations.idiomatic: He was again made Academician of the Hall for Assisting Governance and military prefect of Yongxing while also overseeing transport affairs, promoted to Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, and additionally granted the title of Grand Academician.

sentences.zh: 初，完永興城，或言其非便，詔止其役，雍匿詔而趣成之。

translations.literal: At first, when the walls of Yongxing were being completed, some said it was inadvisable; an edict halted the work, but Yong concealed the edict and hurried to finish it.
translations.idiomatic: When the walls of Yongxing were first being completed, some argued that the project was ill-advised; an edict halted the work, but Yong concealed the edict and hurried to finish it.

sentences.zh: 明年，賊犯定川，邠、岐之間皆恐，而永興獨不憂寇。

translations.literal: The next year the enemy invaded Dingchuan; between Bin and Qi all were afraid, but Yongxing alone did not fear raiders.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the enemy invaded Dingchuan; the region between Bin and Qi was gripped by fear, but Yongxing alone had no fear of raiders.

sentences.zh: 復徙河南府，又遷禮部尚書，卒。

translations.literal: Again transferred to Henan Prefecture, then promoted to Minister of Rites, and died.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to Henan Prefecture, then promoted to Minister of Rites, and died.

sentences.zh: 贈太子太師，諡忠獻。

translations.literal: Posthumously awarded Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent, with posthumous title Loyal and Dedicated.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously awarded the title Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and given the posthumous name Loyal and Dedicated.

sentences.zh: 雍為治尚恕，好謀而少成。

translations.literal: Yong's governance favored clemency; he liked to plan but accomplished little.
translations.idiomatic: Yong governed with a forgiving hand; he liked to devise plans but seldom carried them through.

sentences.zh: 在陝西，嘗請於商、虢置監鑄鐵錢，後不可行；

translations.literal: While in Shaanxi he once requested establishing iron-coin mints at Shang and Guo; later this proved unworkable;
translations.idiomatic: While serving in Shaanxi he once proposed establishing iron-coin mints at Shang and Guo, but the plan later proved unworkable;

sentences.zh: 又括諸路牛以興營田，亦隨廢。

translations.literal: he also requisitioned oxen from all circuits to develop military colonies, and this too was soon abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: he also requisitioned oxen from all circuits to develop military colonies, and that project was soon abandoned as well.

sentences.zh: 頗知人，喜薦士，後多至公卿者。

translations.literal: He was quite good at judging men and liked to recommend scholars; many later reached the rank of high minister.
translations.idiomatic: He had a keen eye for talent and liked to recommend scholars; many of those he promoted later rose to high ministerial rank.

sentences.zh: 狄青為小校時，坐法當斬，雍貸之。

translations.literal: When Di Qing was a junior officer and by law deserved execution, Yong spared him.
translations.idiomatic: When Di Qing was still a junior officer and by law deserved execution, Yong spared his life.

sentences.zh: 子宗傑，為兵部員外郎、直史館，歷陝西轉運使，先雍卒。

translations.literal: His son Zongjie served as vice director of the Ministry of War and compiler at the Historiography Institute, served as Shaanxi transport commissioner, and died before Yong.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zongjie served as vice director of the Ministry of War and compiler at the Historiography Institute, later became Shaanxi transport commissioner, and died before Yong.

sentences.zh: 宗傑子子奇。

translations.literal: Zongjie's son was Ziqi.
translations.idiomatic: Zongjie's son was Ziqi.

sentences.zh: 孫 子奇

translations.literal: Grandson: Ziqi
translations.idiomatic: Grandson: Ziqi

sentences.zh: 子奇，字中濟，階祖雍蔭，簽書幷州判官。

translations.literal: Ziqi, courtesy name Zhongji, entered office through his grandfather Yong's inherited privilege and served as signing secretary and vice-prefect of Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ziqi, styled Zhongji, entered office through the inherited privilege granted to his grandfather Yong and served as signing secretary and vice-prefect of Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以唐介薦，神宗賜對，提舉修在京倉。

translations.literal: On Tang Jie's recommendation, Emperor Shenzong granted him an audience and appointed him to supervise repairs to the capital granaries.
translations.idiomatic: On Tang Jie's recommendation, Emperor Shenzong granted him an audience and put him in charge of repairing the capital granaries.

sentences.zh: 三司使又薦，按覆營繕，匠吏積為欺隱，懼罪，造飛語間之。

translations.literal: The commissioner of the Three Fiscal Departments recommended him again; he investigated construction and repairs, and craftsmen and clerks who had long concealed fraud, fearing punishment, spread slander to undermine him.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner of the Three Fiscal Departments recommended him again; as he investigated construction and repairs, craftsmen and clerks who had long concealed fraud, fearing punishment, spread slander to undermine him.

sentences.zh: 神宗遣大閹張茂則察其無私，勞之曰：「為吏當如是，無恤人言。」

translations.literal: Emperor Shenzong sent the chief eunuch Zhang Maize to investigate and found him free of private interest; he commended him, saying, "An official ought to act like this—do not worry about what people say."
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shenzong sent the chief eunuch Zhang Maize to investigate and found him free of private interest; he commended him, saying, "An official ought to act like this—do not worry about what people say."

sentences.zh: 授戶部判官，為湖南轉運副使。

translations.literal: He was appointed judicial officer of the Households Bureau and made deputy Hunan transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed judicial officer of the Households Bureau and made deputy Hunan transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 建言：「梅山蠻恃險為邊患，宜拓取之。」

translations.literal: He proposed: "The Meishan barbarians rely on rugged terrain to trouble the border; they should be brought under control and taken."
translations.idiomatic: He proposed, "The Meishan tribes rely on rugged terrain to trouble the frontier; the region should be brought under control and annexed."

sentences.zh: 後章惇開五溪，議由此起。

translations.literal: Later, when Zhang Dun opened the Five Streams region, the proposal originated from this.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Zhang Dun opened the Five Streams region, the policy originated in this proposal.

sentences.zh: 入判將作監。

translations.literal: Entered [the capital] to serve as vice director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital to serve as vice director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings.

sentences.zh: 使於遼，導者改路回遠，子奇謂曰：「此去雲中有直道，旬日可至，何為出此？」

translations.literal: Sent as envoy to Liao, when the guides changed the route to a longer detour, Ziqi said to them, "From here there is a direct road to Yunzhong; one can arrive in ten days—why take this way out?"
translations.idiomatic: Sent as envoy to Liao, when the guides changed the route to a longer detour, Ziqi said to them, "From here there is a direct road to Yunzhong that can be reached in ten days—why are we taking this roundabout way?"

sentences.zh: 導者又欲沮子奇下馬館門外，子奇曰：「異時於中門下馬，今何以輒易？」

translations.literal: The guides also wanted to deter Ziqi from dismounting outside the guesthouse gate; Ziqi said, "In former times one dismounted at the middle gate—why should this suddenly be changed?"
translations.idiomatic: The guides also tried to make Ziqi dismount outside the guesthouse gate; Ziqi said, "In former times envoys dismounted at the middle gate—why should that suddenly be changed?"

sentences.zh: 導者計屈。

translations.literal: The guides' scheme failed.
translations.idiomatic: The guides were forced to back down.

sentences.zh: 歷河東、陝西、河北、京東四路轉運使，工部、左司二郎中，加直龍圖閣，使河北。

translations.literal: He served successively as transport commissioner of the Hedong, Shaanxi, Hebei, and Eastern Capital circuits, as vice director in both the Ministry of Works and the Left Bureau, was additionally granted direct appointment to the Dragon Diagram Hall, and was sent to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as transport commissioner of the Hedong, Shaanxi, Hebei, and Eastern Capital circuits, held vice directorships in both the Ministry of Works and the Left Bureau, was additionally granted direct appointment to the Dragon Diagram Hall, and was dispatched to Hebei.

sentences.zh: 諸郡猶榷鹽，奏罷之。

translations.literal: Various prefectures still had state salt monopolies; he memorialized to abolish them.
translations.idiomatic: Various prefectures still maintained state salt monopolies, and he memorialized to abolish them.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，為將作監、司農卿，復使陝西，以病解。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuanyou era he served as director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings and Minister of Revenue for Agriculture, was again sent to Shaanxi, and resigned due to illness.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanyou era he served as director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings and Minister of Revenue for Agriculture, was again dispatched to Shaanxi, and resigned due to illness.

sentences.zh: 起知鄭州，加集賢殿修撰、知河陽。

translations.literal: Recalled to serve as prefect of Zhengzhou, additionally granted compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and made prefect of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to serve as prefect of Zhengzhou, additionally granted the title of compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and made prefect of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 召權戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Summoned to serve as acting Vice Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned to serve as acting Vice Minister of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 刪酒戶苛禁及奴婢告主給賞法。

translations.literal: He abolished harsh restrictions on wine merchants and the law rewarding maidservants and slaves for denouncing their masters.
translations.idiomatic: He abolished harsh restrictions on wine merchants and the law that rewarded maidservants and slaves for denouncing their masters.

sentences.zh: 未幾，出知慶州，廣儲蓄，繕城柵，嚴守備，羈黠羌，推誠待下，人樂為用。

translations.literal: Before long he went out to serve as prefect of Qingzhou; he expanded stores, repaired walls and palisades, tightened defenses, restrained cunning Qiang, treated subordinates with sincerity, and men were glad to serve him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was posted as prefect of Qingzhou; he expanded stores, repaired walls and palisades, tightened defenses, kept cunning Qiang tribes in check, treated his subordinates with sincerity, and his men were glad to serve him.

sentences.zh: 入為吏部侍郎，以待制致仕，卒，年六十三。

translations.literal: He entered [the capital] as Vice Minister of Personnel, retired with the title of awaiting edict, and died at age sixty-three.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to the capital as Vice Minister of Personnel, retired with the title of awaiting edict, and died at the age of sixty-three.

sentences.zh: 子坦。

translations.literal: His son was Tan.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Tan.

sentences.zh: 曾孫 坦

translations.literal: Great-grandson: Tan
translations.idiomatic: Great-grandson: Tan

sentences.zh: 坦，字伯履，以父蔭為開封府推官、金部員外郎、大理少卿，改左司員外郎。

translations.literal: Tan, courtesy name Bolü, through his father's inherited privilege served as judicial officer of Kaifeng Prefecture, vice director of the Gold Bureau, and vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, then was changed to vice director of the Left Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Tan, styled Bolü, entered office through his father's inherited privilege and served as judicial officer of Kaifeng Prefecture, vice director of the Gold Bureau, and vice director of the Court of Judicial Review before being reassigned as vice director of the Left Bureau.

sentences.zh: 押伴夏國使，應對合旨，賜進士第，權起居舍人。

translations.literal: While escorting Xixia envoys, his responses pleased the emperor; he was granted the jinshi degree and made acting recorder of imperial movements.
translations.idiomatic: While escorting Xixia envoys, his responses pleased the emperor; he was granted the jinshi degree and made acting recorder of imperial movements.

sentences.zh: 使於遼，覆命，具語錄以獻。

translations.literal: Sent as envoy to Liao, on reporting back he submitted a full record of the mission.
translations.idiomatic: Sent as envoy to Liao, he submitted a full record of the mission upon his return.

sentences.zh: 徽宗覽而善之，付鴻臚，令後奉使者視為式。

translations.literal: Emperor Huizong read it and approved; he handed it to the Court of State Ceremonial and ordered future envoys to take it as a model.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Huizong read it and approved; he handed it to the Court of State Ceremonial and ordered future envoys to treat it as a model.

sentences.zh: 遷殿中監，知開封府，再命使遼。

translations.literal: Promoted to director of the Palace Domestic Service, made prefect of Kaifeng Prefecture, and again ordered as envoy to Liao.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director of the Palace Domestic Service, made prefect of Kaifeng Prefecture, and again ordered as envoy to Liao.

sentences.zh: 時興邊議，非時遣使以觀釁，坦以不宜始禍，辭其行。

translations.literal: At the time border discussions were underway; envoys were dispatched at an improper time to probe for provocation; Tan felt one should not start trouble and declined the mission.
translations.idiomatic: At the time border discussions were underway and envoys were being dispatched at an inopportune moment to probe for provocation; Tan felt one should not start trouble and declined the mission.

sentences.zh: 徽宗怒，責舒州團練副使，稍復集賢殿修撰，知江寧府、洪揚二州。

translations.literal: Emperor Huizong was angry and demoted him to military training vice-commissioner of Shuzhou; he was later somewhat restored as compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and made prefect of Jiangning Prefecture and the two prefectures of Hong and Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Huizong was angry and demoted him to military training vice-commissioner of Shuzhou; he was later partially restored as compiler at the Hall of Assembled Worthies and made prefect of Jiangning Prefecture and the two prefectures of Hong and Yang.

sentences.zh: 召為戶部侍郎，論當十及夾錫錢之弊。

translations.literal: Summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue, he discussed the evils of value-ten coins and lead-mixed coins.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as Vice Minister of Revenue and discussed the evils of value-ten coins and lead-mixed coins.

sentences.zh: 以便親請外，知河陽。

translations.literal: To be near his relatives he requested an outside post and was made prefect of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: To be near his relatives he requested a provincial post and was made prefect of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 入辭，徽宗曰：「夾錫錢之害，甚於當十，宜速正之，為一道率。」

translations.literal: On taking leave at court, Emperor Huizong said, "The harm of lead-mixed coins exceeds that of value-ten coins; you should quickly rectify this and serve as a model for the whole circuit."
translations.idiomatic: On taking leave at court, Emperor Huizong said, "The harm of lead-mixed coins exceeds that of value-ten coins; you should quickly rectify this and set an example for the whole realm."

sentences.zh: 坦至，即奏罷之。

translations.literal: When Tan arrived, he immediately memorialized to abolish them.
translations.idiomatic: When Tan arrived, he immediately memorialized to abolish them.

sentences.zh: 政和初，復為戶部，遂改當十錢為當三；

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Zhenghe era he again served in the Ministry of Revenue and changed value-ten coins to value-three;
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhenghe era he again served in the Ministry of Revenue and changed value-ten coins to value-three;

sentences.zh: 罷淮鹽入東北；

translations.literal: abolished Huai salt entering the Northeast;
translations.idiomatic: abolished the policy of sending Huai salt into the Northeast;

sentences.zh: 鬻諸州公田，以實常平。

translations.literal: sold public land in various prefectures to fill the Ever-Normal Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: and sold public land in various prefectures to replenish the Ever-Normal Granaries.

sentences.zh: 又上疏言：「戶部歲入有限，用則無窮。

translations.literal: Again he submitted a memorial stating: "The Ministry of Revenue's annual income is limited, but expenditures are inexhaustible.
translations.idiomatic: He also submitted a memorial stating, "The Ministry of Revenue's annual income is limited, but its expenditures are inexhaustible.

sentences.zh: 今節度使八十員，留後至刺史數千員，自非軍功得之，宜減其半俸；

translations.literal: Now there are eighty military commissioners, and military prefects down to prefects number in the thousands; those who did not obtain their posts through military merit should have half their salaries reduced;
translations.idiomatic: There are now eighty military commissioners, and military prefects down to prefects number in the thousands; those who did not earn their posts through military merit should have half their salaries cut;

sentences.zh: 及他工技末作，一切裁損。」

translations.literal: As for other artisan trades and miscellaneous work, all should be cut back."
translations.idiomatic: All other artisan trades and miscellaneous work should be cut back as well."

sentences.zh: 時以為當。

translations.literal: At the time this was considered appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, this was considered appropriate.

sentences.zh: 時張商英為相，坦多與之合。

translations.literal: At the time Zhang Shangying was chancellor, and Tan often agreed with him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Zhang Shangying was chancellor, and Tan often sided with him.

sentences.zh: 及商英去，言者論坦助為匱竭之說，以搖眾聽；

translations.literal: When Shangying left office, critics argued that Tan had helped advance theories of treasury exhaustion to sway public opinion;
translations.idiomatic: When Shangying left office, critics argued that Tan had helped promote claims of fiscal exhaustion in order to sway public opinion;

sentences.zh: 又言坦建議鬻田、改常平法、廢元符令及罷夾錫錢之罪，貶黃州團練副使，安置韶州。

translations.literal: They also cited Tan's crimes of recommending the sale of land, changing the Ever-Normal law, abolishing Yuanfu regulations, and abolishing lead-mixed coins; he was demoted to military training vice-commissioner of Huangzhou and posted to Shaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: They also cited Tan's offenses in recommending the sale of public land, altering the Ever-Normal Granary system, abolishing Yuanfu regulations, and ending lead-mixed coinage; he was demoted to military training vice-commissioner of Huangzhou and posted to Shaozhou.

sentences.zh: 以赦，復徽猷閣待制，卒，年六十二。

translations.literal: Through an amnesty he was restored as awaiting edict at the Huayou Pavilion; he died at age sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: Through an amnesty he was restored as awaiting edict at the Huayou Pavilion; he died at the age of sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 趙稹，字表微。

translations.literal: Zhao Zhen, courtesy name Biaowei.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zhen, styled Biaowei.

sentences.zh: 其先單父人，後徙宣城。

translations.literal: His ancestors were from Shanfu; later they moved to Xuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: His family was originally from Shanfu; they later moved to Xuancheng.

sentences.zh: 為人誠質寬厚，少好學。

translations.literal: In character he was sincere, plain, and generous; from youth he loved learning.
translations.idiomatic: He was sincere, plain, and generous by nature, and from youth he loved learning.

sentences.zh: 吳太府卿田霖退居郡中，名有風鑒，故以女妻稹。

translations.literal: Tian Lin, Master of Court Revenues in Wu, retired and lived in the commandery; renowned for discerning judgment, he therefore gave his daughter in marriage to Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Lin, Master of Court Revenues in Wu, had retired and was living in the commandery; renowned for his discerning judgment, he gave his daughter in marriage to Zhen.

sentences.zh: 擢進士第，歷平定軍判官、台州推官。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as judicial officer of the Pingding Army and investigative officer of Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and successively served as judicial officer of the Pingding Army and investigative officer of Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 改大理寺丞、知昆山縣，通判楚州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, made magistrate of Kunshan County, and served as military vice-prefect of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review, made magistrate of Kunshan County, and served as military vice-prefect of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷殿中丞、知通州。

translations.literal: Promoted to palace assistant director and made prefect of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to palace assistant director and made prefect of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 召還，同判宗正寺，樞密直學士李浚薦為監察御史，再遷侍御史、判登聞鼓院、開封府判官，徙三司開拆、憑由司。

translations.literal: Recalled to the capital, he served concurrently at the Court of the Imperial Clan; Privy Council academician Li Jun recommended him as supervising censor; he was again promoted to attendant censor, judge of the Drum-beating Court for Appeals, and judicial officer of Kaifeng Prefecture, then transferred to the Three Departments Commission's Document Opening and Voucher Office.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to the capital, he served concurrently at the Court of the Imperial Clan; Privy Council academician Li Jun recommended him as supervising censor; he was then promoted to attendant censor, judge of the Drum-beating Court for Appeals, and judicial officer of Kaifeng Prefecture, before being transferred to the Three Departments Commission's Document Opening and Voucher Office.

sentences.zh: 帝祀汾陰，為留守推官。

translations.literal: When the emperor performed sacrifice at Fenyin, he served as investigative officer for the stay-behind administration.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor performed sacrifice at Fenyin, he served as investigative officer for the stay-behind administration.

sentences.zh: 遷尚書兵部員外郎、益州路轉運使，真宗諭曰：「蜀遠而數亂，其利害朕所欲聞。

translations.literal: Promoted to vice director of the Ministry of War in the Secretariat and transport commissioner of Yizhou Circuit; Emperor Zhenzong instructed him: "Shu is remote and has often been turbulent; its advantages and disadvantages are what I wish to hear.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director of the Ministry of War in the Secretariat and transport commissioner of Yizhou Circuit; Emperor Zhenzong instructed him, "Shu is remote and has often been turbulent; I want to hear about its advantages and disadvantages.

sentences.zh: 卿至，悉條上之，祗附常奏，毋著姓名。」

translations.literal: When you arrive, list everything and submit it; attach it only to your regular memorials and do not sign your name."
translations.idiomatic: When you arrive, list everything and submit it; attach it only to your regular memorials and do not sign your name."

sentences.zh: 稹至，數言部中事，至一日章數上。

translations.literal: When Zhen arrived, he frequently reported affairs in his region, sometimes submitting several memorials in a single day.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhen arrived, he frequently reported affairs in his circuit, sometimes submitting several memorials in a single day.

sentences.zh: 蒲江縣捕劫盜不得，反逮繫平民，楚掠誣服。

translations.literal: In Pujiang County they failed to capture bandits and instead arrested and imprisoned common people, torturing them until they falsely confessed.
translations.idiomatic: In Pujiang County the authorities failed to capture bandits and instead arrested and imprisoned commoners, torturing them until they falsely confessed.

sentences.zh: 稹適行部，意其冤，馳入縣獄，問得狀，悉縱之。

translations.literal: Zhen happened to be on an inspection tour; suspecting injustice, he galloped into the county jail, questioned them and learned the facts, and released them all.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen happened to be on an inspection tour; suspecting injustice, he galloped into the county jail, questioned the prisoners and learned the truth, and released them all.

sentences.zh: 遷工部郎中。

translations.literal: Promoted to director of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 召為侍御史知雜事、同判吏部流內銓，糾察在京刑獄。

translations.literal: Recalled to serve as attendant censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs and concurrent judge of the Ministry of Personnel's Stream-Within Selection Board, investigating capital criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to serve as attendant censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs and concurrent judge of the Ministry of Personnel's Stream-Within Selection Board, with responsibility for investigating criminal cases in the capital.

sentences.zh: 慎從吉知開封府，其子鈞、銳受賕，事連錢惟演。

translations.literal: Shen Congji was prefect of Kaifeng; his sons Jun and Rui accepted bribes, implicating Qian Weiyan.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Congji was prefect of Kaifeng; his sons Jun and Rui accepted bribes, and the case implicated Qian Weiyan.

sentences.zh: 稹與王曾白其姦狀，從吉坐免，惟演亦罷去。

translations.literal: Zhen and Wang Zeng reported their corrupt conduct; Congji was dismissed from office, and Weiyan was also removed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen and Wang Zeng reported their corrupt conduct; Congji was dismissed from office, and Weiyan was removed as well.

sentences.zh: 改三司鹽鐵副使，擢右諫議大夫、集賢院學士、知益州。

translations.literal: Transferred to vice commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau of the Three Departments Commission; promoted to Right Remonstrance Grandee, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and made prefect of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice commissioner of the Salt and Iron Bureau of the Three Departments Commission and promoted to Right Remonstrance Grandee, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and prefect of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 度支市錦六千匹，召工計歲織裁千餘匹，止以歲所織數上供。

translations.literal: The Revenue Bureau had ordered six thousand bolts of brocade; summoning artisans to calculate annual production yielded only a little over a thousand bolts, so he submitted only the year's woven amount as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Revenue Bureau had ordered six thousand bolts of brocade; when artisans calculated annual production, it came to only a little over a thousand bolts, so he submitted only the year's actual output as tribute.

sentences.zh: 久之，或言稹不達民情，喜尊大，降知同州，徙鳳翔、京兆府，三遷工部侍郎，復糾察在京刑獄。

translations.literal: After some time, some said Zhen did not understand popular sentiment and enjoyed putting on airs; he was demoted to prefect of Tongzhou, transferred to Fengxiang and Jingzhao Prefectures, promoted three times to vice minister of Works, and again investigated capital criminal cases.
translations.idiomatic: After some time, critics said Zhen did not understand popular sentiment and enjoyed putting on airs; he was demoted to prefect of Tongzhou, transferred to Fengxiang and Jingzhao Prefectures, promoted three times to vice minister of Works, and again given responsibility for investigating criminal cases in the capital.

sentences.zh: 加樞密直學士、知幷州，代還，遷刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: Given the title Privy Council academician and made prefect of Bingzhou; on returning from his term, promoted to vice minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the title Privy Council academician and made prefect of Bingzhou; on returning from his term, he was promoted to vice minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 天聖八年，擢樞密副使，遷吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tiansheng, promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council and transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tiansheng, he was promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council and transferred to Vice Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 時，權出宮掖，稹厚結劉美人家婢，以故致位政府。

translations.literal: At the time power emanated from the inner palace; Zhen formed close ties with the maidservant of Liu Mei's household, and through this rose to a position in the government.
translations.idiomatic: At the time power emanated from the inner palace; Zhen cultivated close ties with a maidservant in Liu Mei's household, and through this rose to a position in the government.

sentences.zh: 命未出，人馳告稹，稹問曰：「“東頭？

translations.literal: Before the appointment was issued, someone rushed to tell Zhen; Zhen asked: "The east side?
translations.idiomatic: Before the appointment was issued, someone rushed to tell Zhen; Zhen asked, "The east side?

sentences.zh: 西頭？」

translations.literal: The west side?"
translations.idiomatic: The west side?"

sentences.zh: 蓋意在中書也。

translations.literal: For he hoped for the Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: For he was hoping for the Directorate.

sentences.zh: 聞者皆以為笑。

translations.literal: Those who heard it all laughed.
translations.idiomatic: Those who heard it all laughed.

sentences.zh: 章獻太后崩，罷為尚書左丞、知河中府，遷禮部尚書。

translations.literal: When Empress Zhangxian died, he was removed as Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, made prefect of Hezhong Prefecture, then promoted to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Zhangxian died, he was removed as Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, made prefect of Hezhong Prefecture, and later promoted to Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 既病，乞骸骨，拜太子少傅致仕。

translations.literal: When he fell ill, he requested to retire; granted the title of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired.
translations.idiomatic: When he fell ill, he requested retirement; he was granted the title of Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太子太保，諡僖質。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously given Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent; posthumous name Xizhi.
translations.idiomatic: He died; he was posthumously given the title Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous name Xizhi.

sentences.zh: 任布，字應之，河南人。

translations.literal: Ren Bu, courtesy name Yingzhi, a native of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Bu, styled Yingzhi, was a native of Henan.

sentences.zh: 後唐宰相圜四世孫也。

translations.literal: He was a fourth-generation descendant of the Later Tang chancellor Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was a fourth-generation descendant of the Later Tang chancellor Yuan.

sentences.zh: 力學，家貧，嘗從人借書以讀。

translations.literal: He studied diligently; his family was poor and he often borrowed books from others to read.
translations.idiomatic: He studied diligently; his family was poor, and he often borrowed books from others to read.

sentences.zh: 進士及第，補安肅軍判官，輒刺問虜中事，上疏請飭邊備，仍奏河北利害。

translations.literal: Passing the jinshi examination, he was appointed judicial officer of the Ansu Army; he frequently gathered intelligence on affairs among the barbarians, submitted memorials requesting strengthened border defenses, and also memorialized on Hebei's advantages and disadvantages.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the jinshi examination, he was appointed judicial officer of the Ansu Army; he frequently gathered intelligence on affairs among the barbarians, submitted memorials calling for stronger border defenses, and also memorialized on the advantages and disadvantages of Hebei.

sentences.zh: 後契丹至澶淵，真宗識其名，特改大理寺丞、知安陽縣。

translations.literal: Later when the Khitan reached Chanyuan, Zhenzong recognized his name and specially made him assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review and magistrate of Anyang County.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when the Khitan reached Chanyuan, Zhenzong recognized his name and specially appointed him assistant director of the Court of Judicial Review and magistrate of Anyang County.

sentences.zh: 通判嘉州，還，知開封府司錄事，通判大名府。

translations.literal: Military vice-prefect of Jiazhou; on return, registrar of Kaifeng Prefecture, military vice-prefect of Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served as military vice-prefect of Jiazhou; on returning to the capital, he was registrar of Kaifeng Prefecture and then military vice-prefect of Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初置提點刑獄，選布領荊湖南路。

translations.literal: When the judicial intendant post was first established, Bu was chosen to oversee Jinghu South Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: When the judicial intendant post was first established, Bu was chosen to oversee Jinghu South Circuit.

sentences.zh: 入權三司鹽鐵判官，判度支勾院。

translations.literal: Entered the capital as acting Salt and Iron Bureau commissioner and judge of the Revenue Bureau's Audit Office.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as acting Salt and Iron Bureau commissioner and judge of the Revenue Bureau's Audit Office.

sentences.zh: 京城東南有泉湧出，為築祥源觀，男女徒跣奔走瞻拜。

translations.literal: Southeast of the capital a spring burst forth; the Xiangyuan Temple was built for it; men and women ran barefoot to look on and worship.
translations.idiomatic: Southeast of the capital a spring burst forth; the Xiangyuan Temple was built for it, and men and women ran barefoot to look on and worship.

sentences.zh: 布論之曰：「明朝不宜以神怪衒愚俗。」

translations.literal: Bu argued: "A bright dynasty should not use supernatural wonders to dazzle the common folk."
translations.idiomatic: Bu argued, "A bright dynasty should not use supernatural wonders to dazzle the common folk."

sentences.zh: 遂忤宰相意。

translations.literal: This offended the chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: This offended the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 又與徐奭、麻溫其試開封府進士，而奭潛發封卷視之。

translations.literal: Also, while serving with Xu Yi and Ma Wenqi as examiners for Kaifeng jinshi candidates, Yi secretly broke the seal on the exam papers to look at them.
translations.idiomatic: Also, while serving with Xu Yi and Ma Wenqi as examiners for Kaifeng jinshi candidates, Yi secretly broke the seal on the exam papers to look at them.

sentences.zh: 降監鄧州稅，徙知宿州。

translations.literal: Demoted to tax supervisor of Dengzhou; transferred to prefect of Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was demoted to tax supervisor of Dengzhou and transferred to prefect of Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 時越州守闕，寇準曰：「越州有職分田，歲入且厚，今爭者頗眾，非廉士莫可予。」

translations.literal: The prefecture of Yuezhou was vacant; Kou Zhun said: "Yuezhou has official fields with substantial annual income; many are competing for it — only an incorruptible man should be given it."
translations.idiomatic: The prefecture of Yuezhou was vacant; Kou Zhun said, "Yuezhou has official fields with substantial annual income, and many are competing for the post — only an incorruptible man should be given it."

sentences.zh: 乃徙布越州。

translations.literal: So Bu was transferred to Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Bu was therefore transferred to Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 有祖訟其孫者「醉酒詈我」，已而悔，日哭於庭曰：「我老無子，賴此孫以為命也。」

translations.literal: A grandfather sued his grandson, saying "he cursed me while drunk"; later regretting it, he daily wept in the courtyard: "I am old and without sons; I depend on this grandson for my livelihood."
translations.idiomatic: A grandfather sued his grandson, claiming that "he cursed me while drunk"; later regretting it, he wept daily in the courtyard, saying, "I am old and without sons; I depend on this grandson for my livelihood."

sentences.zh: 布聞之，貸其死，上書自劾，朝廷亦不之責。

translations.literal: When Bu heard this, he spared the grandson from the death penalty and submitted a memorial impeaching himself; the court did not hold him accountable.
translations.idiomatic: When Bu heard this, he spared the grandson from the death penalty and submitted a memorial impeaching himself; the court did not hold him accountable.

sentences.zh: 寇準貶，布亦徙建州，累遷尚書職方員外郎。

translations.literal: When Kou Zhun was demoted, Bu was also transferred to Jianzhou; he was promoted cumulatively to vice director of the Armory Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: When Kou Zhun was demoted, Bu was also transferred to Jianzhou; he was promoted cumulatively to vice director of the Armory Bureau.

sentences.zh: 丁謂既逐，稍用為白波發運使。

translations.literal: After Ding Wei was expelled, Bu was gradually reemployed as commissioner for transport on the Baibo Canal.
translations.idiomatic: After Ding Wei was expelled, Bu was gradually reemployed as commissioner for transport on the Baibo Canal.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，判三司開拆司，出為梓州路轉運使。

translations.literal: After a little over a year, judge of the Three Departments Document Opening Office; posted out as transport commissioner of Zizhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: After a little over a year, he served as judge of the Three Departments Document Opening Office, then was posted out as transport commissioner of Zizhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 富順監鹽井，歲久鹵薄而課存，主者至破產，或鬻子孫不能償。

translations.literal: At the Fushun salt well office, over the years the brine had thinned but the tax quota remained; administrators went bankrupt, some even selling children and grandchildren yet unable to pay.
translations.idiomatic: At the Fushun salt well office, over the years the brine had thinned but the tax quota remained unchanged; administrators went bankrupt, and some even sold their children and grandchildren yet still could not pay.

sentences.zh: 布奏除之。

translations.literal: Bu memorialized to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: Bu memorialized to abolish the quota.

sentences.zh: 遷祠部郎中、權戶部判官，擢江、淮制置發運使。

translations.literal: Promoted to director of the Ceremonial Bureau, acting judge of the Ministry of Revenue; elevated to commissioner for organized transport on the Jiang and Huai.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to director of the Ceremonial Bureau and acting judge of the Ministry of Revenue, then elevated to commissioner for organized transport on the Jiang and Huai.

sentences.zh: 前使者多聚山海珍異之物以餉權要，布一切罷去。

translations.literal: Previous commissioners often gathered rare treasures from mountains and seas to present to power brokers; Bu abolished all of this.
translations.idiomatic: Previous commissioners often gathered rare treasures from mountains and seas to present to powerful officials; Bu abolished the practice entirely.

sentences.zh: 召為三司度支副使，奉使契丹。

translations.literal: Recalled as vice commissioner of the Revenue Bureau of the Three Departments; sent as envoy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled as vice commissioner of the Revenue Bureau of the Three Departments and sent as envoy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 還，加直史館、知荊南。

translations.literal: On return, given directorship of the History Institute and made prefect of Jingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On his return, he was given directorship of the History Institute and made prefect of Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 為鹽鐵副使，命管伴契丹使。

translations.literal: Served as Salt and Iron vice commissioner; ordered to escort Khitan envoys.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Salt and Iron vice commissioner and was ordered to escort Khitan envoys.

sentences.zh: 歷兵部、刑部郎中，拜右諫議大夫、知真定府。

translations.literal: Served successively as director of the Ministries of War and Justice; appointed Right Remonstrance Grandee and made prefect of Zhending Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as director of the Ministries of War and Justice, then was appointed Right Remonstrance Grandee and made prefect of Zhending Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 或欲省河北兵，布言：「“契丹、西夏方窺伺中國，備未可弛也。」

translations.literal: Some wished to reduce Hebei troops; Bu said: "The Khitan and Western Xia are watching China — preparedness cannot be relaxed."
translations.idiomatic: Some wished to reduce Hebei troops; Bu said, "The Khitan and Western Xia are watching China — our defenses cannot be relaxed."

sentences.zh: 築甬道屬滹沱河，跨絕泥潦。

translations.literal: He built an elevated causeway linked to the Hutuo River, spanning muddy floods.
translations.idiomatic: He built an elevated causeway linked to the Hutuo River, spanning muddy floodwaters.

sentences.zh: 徙滑州，改天雄軍。

translations.literal: Transferred to Huazhou; changed to Tianxiong Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Huazhou, then reassigned to the Tianxiong Army.

sentences.zh: 遷給事中、集賢院學士、知許州。

translations.literal: Promoted to drafter of edicts, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and prefect of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to drafter of edicts, academician of the Hall of Assembled Worthies, and prefect of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 未幾，為龍圖閣直學士，徙澶州。

translations.literal: Before long, made Hall of Dragon Pictures academician and transferred to Chunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, he was made Hall of Dragon Pictures academician and transferred to Chunzhou.

sentences.zh: 黃德和誣劉平降賊，欲收平家，布力言平非降賊者。

translations.literal: Huang Dehe falsely accused Liu Ping of surrendering to the bandits and sought to confiscate Ping's family property; Bu strongly argued that Ping had not surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Dehe falsely accused Liu Ping of surrendering to the bandits and sought to confiscate Ping's family property; Bu strongly argued that Ping had not surrendered to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 復徙真定，又徙河南府，未至，召為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Again transferred to Zhending, then to Henan Prefecture; before arriving, summoned as Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: He was again transferred to Zhending, then to Henan Prefecture; before he arrived, he was summoned as Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 布純約自守，及秉政，無所建明。

translations.literal: Bu was upright and restrained in self-preservation; once in power he proposed nothing notable.
translations.idiomatic: Bu was upright and restrained by nature; once in power, he proposed nothing notable.

sentences.zh: 子遜嘗上書，詆大臣及布皆為不才，御史魚周詢因奏疏曰「布不才，其子能知之。」

translations.literal: His son Xun once submitted a memorial slandering senior ministers and declaring Bu incompetent as well; censor Yu Zhouxun thereupon submitted a memorial saying "Bu is incompetent — his son can tell."
translations.idiomatic: His son Xun once submitted a memorial slandering senior ministers and declaring that Bu, too, was incompetent; censor Yu Zhouxun thereupon submitted a memorial saying, "Bu is incompetent — his son can tell."

sentences.zh: 乃以尚書工部侍郎罷知河陽。

translations.literal: He was thus removed as Vice Minister of Works and made prefect of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: Bu was thus removed as Vice Minister of Works and made prefect of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 議者以周詢引遜語逐其父，為不知體。

translations.literal: Commentators held that Zhouxun had used Xun's words to expel his father — a failure of propriety.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators held that Zhouxun had used Xun's words to expel his father, which showed a lack of proper judgment.

sentences.zh: 改蔡州，授太子少保致仕，進少傅。

translations.literal: Transferred to Caizhou; granted Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired; promoted to Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Caizhou, granted the title Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent and retired, and promoted to Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 皇祐間，詔陪祀明堂，稱疾不赴。

translations.literal: During the Huangyou era, ordered to attend the Bright Hall sacrifice; he claimed illness and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: During the Huangyou era, he was ordered to attend the Bright Hall sacrifice; he claimed illness and did not go.

sentences.zh: 賜一子進士出身，遷少師。

translations.literal: One son was granted jinshi status by imperial favor; promoted to Junior Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: One of his sons was granted jinshi status by imperial favor, and Bu was promoted to Junior Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 始，布歸洛中，作「五知堂」，謂知恩、知道、知命、知足、知幸也。

translations.literal: Initially, when Bu returned to Luoyang, he built the "Hall of Five Knowledges" — knowing gratitude, knowing the Way, knowing fate, knowing sufficiency, and knowing fortune.
translations.idiomatic: When Bu first returned to Luoyang, he built the "Hall of Five Knowledges" — knowing gratitude, knowing the Way, knowing fate, knowing sufficiency, and knowing good fortune.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈太子太傅，諡恭惠。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously given Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent; posthumous name Gonghui.
translations.idiomatic: He died; he was posthumously given the title Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, with the posthumous name Gonghui.

sentences.zh: 子達，性亦恬遠，尚釋氏學，曆官為司封郎中。

translations.literal: His son Da was also tranquil and aloof in nature, devoted to Buddhist studies, and through offices reached director of the Seals Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: His son Da was also tranquil and aloof by nature, devoted to Buddhist studies, and through successive offices reached director of the Seals Bureau.

sentences.zh: 高若訥

translations.literal: Gao Ruone
translations.idiomatic: Gao Ruone

sentences.zh: 高若訥，字敏之，本幷州榆次人，徙家衛州。

translations.literal: Gao Ruone, courtesy name Minzhi, originally from Yuci in Bingzhou; his family moved to Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Ruone, styled Minzhi, was originally from Yuci in Bingzhou; his family later moved to Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 進士及第，補彰德軍節度推官，改秘書省著作佐郎，再遷太常博士、知商河縣。

translations.literal: Passed the jinshi examination; appointed investigative officer of the Zhangde Army military commission; transferred to assistant compiler of the Secretariat; promoted again to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and magistrate of Shanghe County.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the jinshi examination, he was appointed investigative officer of the Zhangde Army military commission; he was transferred to assistant compiler of the Secretariat and later promoted to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and magistrate of Shanghe County.

sentences.zh: 縣有職分田，而牛與種皆假於民，若訥獨廢不耕。

translations.literal: The county had official fields, but oxen and seed were borrowed from the people; Ruone alone let them lie fallow and did not cultivate them.
translations.idiomatic: The county had official fields, but oxen and seed were borrowed from the people; Ruone alone let them lie fallow and refused to cultivate them.

sentences.zh: 御史知雜楊偕薦為監察御史裏行，遷尚書主客員外郎、殿中侍御史裏行。

translations.literal: Supervising censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs Yang Jie recommended him as probationary supervising censor; promoted to vice director of the Host-Guest Bureau and probationary palace censor.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs Yang Jie recommended him as probationary supervising censor; he was promoted to vice director of the Host-Guest Bureau and probationary palace censor.

sentences.zh: 改左司諫、同管勾國子監，遷起居舍人、知諫院。

translations.literal: Changed to Left Bureau remonstrator, concurrent superintendent of the Directorate of Education; promoted to recorder of imperial movements and director of the Remonstrance Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was changed to Left Bureau remonstrator and concurrent superintendent of the Directorate of Education, then promoted to recorder of imperial movements and director of the Remonstrance Bureau.

sentences.zh: 時范仲淹坐言事奪職知睦州，余靖、尹洙論救仲淹，相繼貶斥。

translations.literal: At the time Fan Zhongyan was stripped of office for speaking out and made prefect of Muzhou; Yu Jing and Yin Zhu argued in his defense and were successively demoted and expelled.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Fan Zhongyan was stripped of office for speaking out and made prefect of Muzhou; Yu Jing and Yin Zhu argued in his defense and were successively demoted and expelled.

sentences.zh: 歐陽修乃移書責若訥曰：「仲淹剛正，通古今，班行中無比。

translations.literal: Ouyang Xiu then sent a letter rebuking Ruone: "Zhongyan is upright and firm, versed in past and present — unmatched among court officials.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Xiu then sent a letter rebuking Ruone, saying, "Zhongyan is upright and firm, versed in past and present — unmatched among court officials.

sentences.zh: 以非辜逐，君為諫官不能辨，猶以面目見士大夫，出入朝廷，是不復知人間有羞恥事耶！

translations.literal: Innocently expelled, and you as remonstrator cannot speak for him — yet you still show your face among gentlemen and come and go at court. Do you no longer know shame exists in this world?
translations.idiomatic: Innocently expelled, and you as remonstrator cannot speak for him — yet you still show your face among gentlemen and come and go at court. Do you no longer know that shame exists in this world?

sentences.zh: 今而後，決知足下非君子”」若訥忿，以其書奏，貶修夷陵令。

translations.literal: From now on, I am convinced you are no gentleman." Ruone was incensed and submitted the letter to court; Xiu was demoted to magistrate of Yiling.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, I am convinced you are no gentleman." Ruone was incensed and submitted the letter to court; Xiu was demoted to magistrate of Yiling.

sentences.zh: 未幾，加直史館，以刑部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事。

translations.literal: Before long, given directorship of the History Institute; as vice director of Justice concurrently served as attendant censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, he was given directorship of the History Institute and, as vice director of Justice, concurrently served as attendant censor in charge of miscellaneous affairs.

sentences.zh: 王蒙正知蔡州，若訥言：「蒙正起裨販，因緣戚里得官。

translations.literal: Wang Mengzheng was to be prefect of Caizhou; Ruone said: "Mengzheng rose from peddling and gained office through imperial in-laws.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mengzheng was to be prefect of Caizhou; Ruone said, "Mengzheng rose from peddling and gained office through imperial in-laws.

sentences.zh: 向徙郴州，物論猶不平，今予之大州，可乎？」

translations.literal: Previously transferred to Chenzhou, public opinion was still not appeased; now to give him a major prefecture — is that acceptable?"
translations.idiomatic: Previously transferred to Chenzhou, public opinion was still not appeased; now to give him a major prefecture — is that acceptable?"

sentences.zh: 詔寢其命。

translations.literal: The edict was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The edict was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 大慶殿設祈福道場，若訥奏曰：「大慶殿非行禮不御，非法服不坐，國之路寢也，豈可聚老、釋為瀆慢？」

translations.literal: A prayer ritual was set up in the Great Celebration Hall; Ruone memorialized: "The Great Celebration Hall is entered only for ceremonies, seated in only in proper ritual dress — it is the state's inner chamber. How can Daoist and Buddhist clergy be assembled there in irreverence?"
translations.idiomatic: A prayer ritual was set up in the Great Celebration Hall; Ruone memorialized, "The Great Celebration Hall is entered only for ceremonies and seated in only in proper ritual dress — it is the state's inner chamber. How can Daoist and Buddhist clergy be assembled there in irreverence?"

sentences.zh: 閻文應為入內都知，若訥言其肆橫不法，請出之，遂出文應為相州兵馬鈐轄。

translations.literal: Yan Wenying was inner palace director; Ruone said he acted outrageously and unlawfully and requested his removal; Wenying was therefore posted out as military commander of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Wenying was inner palace director; Ruone said he acted outrageously and unlawfully and requested his removal; Wenying was therefore posted out as military commander of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 又奏三公坐而論道，今二府對才數刻，何以盡萬機？

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "The Three Dukes were said to sit and discuss the Way; today the Two Departments face the throne for only a few quarters of an hour — how can they exhaust the myriad affairs of state?"
translations.idiomatic: He also memorialized, "The Three Dukes were said to sit and discuss the Way; today the Two Departments face the throne for only a few quarters of an hour — how can they exhaust the myriad affairs of state?"

sentences.zh: 宜賜坐從容，如唐延英故事。

translations.literal: They should be granted seats and discuss at leisure, following the Tang precedent of the Yan Ying Hall.
translations.idiomatic: They should be granted seats and allowed to discuss affairs at leisure, following the Tang precedent of the Yan Ying Hall.

sentences.zh: 擢天章閣待制、知永興軍，留判吏部流內銓，出為河東路都轉運使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Hanlin Secretariat attendant and military commissioner of Yongxing Army, retained to judge the Ministry of Personnel's flow inner selection board, then posted out as grand transport commissioner of Hedong Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Hanlin Secretariat attendant and military commissioner of Yongxing Army, retained to judge the Ministry of Personnel's flow inner selection board, then posted out as grand transport commissioner of Hedong Circuit.

sentences.zh: 召還，兼侍讀、權判尚書刑部。

translations.literal: Recalled; concurrently imperial reader and acting judge of the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled, concurrently served as imperial reader, and was given acting charge of the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，始許行服，給實俸終喪。

translations.literal: On his mother's death he entered mourning; for the first time he was permitted to wear mourning garb and was granted full salary throughout the mourning period.
translations.idiomatic: When his mother died, he entered mourning; for the first time he was permitted to observe the full mourning rites and was granted his full salary for the entire period.

sentences.zh: 服除，加龍圖閣直學士、史館修撰，以右諫議大夫權御史中丞。

translations.literal: When mourning ended, he was given Dragon Hall academician and history compiler; as Right Remonstrance Grandee he acted as censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended, he was made Dragon Hall academician and history compiler, and as Right Remonstrance Grandee he acted as censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 時宰相賈昌朝與參知政事吳育數爭事上前。

translations.literal: At the time Chancellor Jia Changchao and co-administrator Wu Yu repeatedly argued over affairs before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Chancellor Jia Changchao and co-administrator Wu Yu repeatedly quarreled over policy before the throne.

sentences.zh: 明年春，大旱，帝問所以然者，若訥曰：「陰陽不和，責在宰相。

translations.literal: The next spring there was a great drought; when the Emperor asked the cause, Ruone said: "Yin and yang are not in harmony — the blame lies with the chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: The next spring there was a great drought; when the Emperor asked the cause, Ruone said, "Yin and yang are not in harmony — the blame lies with the chancellor.

sentences.zh: 《洪範》，大臣不肅，則雨不時若。」

translations.literal: The Grand Plan says: when senior ministers are not reverent, rain does not come at the proper time."
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Plan says that when senior ministers are not reverent, rain does not come at the proper time."

sentences.zh: 於是昌朝及育皆罷，若訥遂代育為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Thereupon both Changchao and Yu were dismissed, and Ruone then replaced Yu as Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon both Changchao and Yu were dismissed, and Ruone then replaced Yu as Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 王則據貝州，討之，逾月未下。

translations.literal: Wang Ze held Beizhou; troops were sent against him, but after more than a month the city had not fallen.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Ze seized Beizhou; government forces were sent against him, but after more than a month the city still had not fallen.

sentences.zh: 或議招降，若訥言：「河朔重兵所積，今釋不討，後且啟亂階。」

translations.literal: Some proposed accepting surrender; Ruone said: "Hebei is where heavy troops are concentrated; if we now let him go unpunished, later it will open the door to rebellion."
translations.idiomatic: Some proposed accepting surrender; Ruone said, "Hebei is where heavy troops are concentrated; if we now let him go unpunished, we will only invite rebellion later."

sentences.zh: 及破城，知州張得一送御史臺劾治，有臣賊狀。

translations.literal: When the city fell, prefect Zhang Deyi was sent to the Censorate for investigation; there was evidence he had submitted to the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, prefect Zhang Deyi was sent to the Censorate for investigation, and evidence showed he had submitted to the bandits.

sentences.zh: 朝廷議貸死，若訥謂：「守臣不死，自當誅，況為賊屈？」

translations.literal: The court discussed sparing his life; Ruone said: "A defending official who did not die should be executed in any case — how much more when he submitted to bandits?"
translations.idiomatic: The court discussed sparing his life; Ruone said, "A defending official who did not die should be executed in any case — how much more when he submitted to the rebels?"

sentences.zh: 得一遂棄市。

translations.literal: Deyi was therefore executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Deyi was therefore executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 以工部侍郎、參知政事為樞密使。

translations.literal: As Vice Minister of Works and co-administrator, he became Commissioner of the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: With the titles of Vice Minister of Works and co-administrator, he became Commissioner of the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 凡內降恩，若訥多覆奏不行。

translations.literal: For all imperial grants of favor issued from within the palace, Ruone often submitted counter-memorials and refused to implement them.
translations.idiomatic: For all imperial grants of favor issued from within the palace, Ruone often submitted counter-memorials and blocked their implementation.

sentences.zh: 入內都知王守忠欲得節度使，固執為不可。

translations.literal: Inner palace director Wang Shouzhong wished to obtain a military governorship; Ruone firmly insisted it was impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Inner palace director Wang Shouzhong wished to obtain a military governorship, but Ruone firmly refused to allow it.

sentences.zh: 若訥畏惕少過，而前騶驅路人輒至死，御史奏彈之。

translations.literal: Ruone's reverence was slightly excessive, yet his outriders clearing the road often killed passersby; censors memorialized to impeach him.
translations.idiomatic: Ruone was overly punctilious in ceremony, yet his outriders clearing the road often killed passersby; censors memorialized to impeach him.

sentences.zh: 皇祐五年，罷為觀文殿學士兼翰林侍讀學士、尚書左丞、同群牧制置使、判尚書都省，止命舍人草詞。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Huangyou, he was dismissed and made Hall of Observed Culture academician, concurrent Hanlin reader academician, Left Vice Minister of State Affairs, joint livestock commissioner, and judge of the General Secretariat; only an academy member was ordered to draft the appointment edict.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Huangyou, he was dismissed and made Hall of Observed Culture academician, concurrent Hanlin reader academician, Left Vice Minister of State Affairs, joint livestock commissioner, and judge of the General Secretariat — a slight, for only an academy member was ordered to draft the appointment edict.

sentences.zh: 卒，贈右僕射，諡文莊。

translations.literal: He died; posthumously given Right Vice Director; posthumous name Wenzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died; he was posthumously given the title Right Vice Director, with the posthumous name Wenzhuang.

sentences.zh: 若訥強學善記，自秦、漢以來諸傳記無不該通，尤喜申、韓、管子之書，頗明曆學。

translations.literal: Ruone studied vigorously and remembered well; from Qin and Han onward all biographies and records were comprehensively mastered; he especially favored the books of Shenzi, Han Feizi, and Master Guan, and was also well versed in calendrical studies.
translations.idiomatic: Ruone was a forceful scholar with an excellent memory; from Qin and Han onward he mastered every sort of biography and record; he especially favored the books of Shenzi, Han Feizi, and Master Guan, and was also well versed in calendrical studies.

sentences.zh: 因母病，遂兼通醫書，雖國醫皆屈伏。

translations.literal: Because of his mother's illness, he also mastered medical texts; even imperial physicians bowed to his skill.
translations.idiomatic: Because of his mother's illness, he also mastered medical texts, and even imperial physicians acknowledged his superiority.

sentences.zh: 張仲景《傷寒論訣》、孫思邈《方書》及《外台秘要》久不傳，悉考校訛謬行之，世始知有是書。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhongjing's Treatise on Cold Damage Key Points, Sun Simiao's Formularies, and the Arcane Essentials from the Imperial Library had long ceased to circulate; he collated their errors and published them, and the world first came to know these books existed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhongjing's Treatise on Cold Damage Key Points, Sun Simiao's Formularies, and the Arcane Essentials from the Imperial Library had long ceased to circulate; he collated their errors and published corrected editions, and the world first learned that these books existed.

sentences.zh: 名醫多出衛州，皆本高氏學焉。

translations.literal: Famous physicians mostly came from Weizhou, all studying from the Gao family's teachings.
translations.idiomatic: Most famous physicians came from Weizhou, all trained in the Gao family's medical tradition.

sentences.zh: 皇祐中，詔累黍定尺以製鍾律，爭論連年不決。

translations.literal: During Huangyou, an edict ordered determining the foot measure by stacking millet grains to make bell pitch pipes; debate continued for years without resolution.
translations.idiomatic: During Huangyou, an edict ordered determining the standard foot measure by stacking millet grains in order to fix bell pitch pipes; debate continued for years without resolution.

sentences.zh: 若訥以漢貨泉度一寸，依《隋書》定尺十五種上之。

translations.literal: Ruone measured one inch by the Han huòquán coin and, following the Book of Sui, submitted fifteen types of standardized foot measures.
translations.idiomatic: Ruone measured one inch by the Han huòquán coin and, following the Book of Sui, submitted fifteen standardized foot measures to the throne.

sentences.zh: 並損益祠祭服器，悉施用。

translations.literal: He also revised sacrificial vestments and vessels, all of which were adopted.
translations.idiomatic: He also revised sacrificial vestments and vessels, all of which were put into use.

sentences.zh: 有集二十卷。

translations.literal: He had a collected works in twenty juan.
translations.idiomatic: He left a collected works in twenty juan.

sentences.zh: 孫沔，字元規，越州會稽人。

translations.literal: Sun Mian, courtesy name Yuangui, a native of Kuaiji in Yuezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Mian, styled Yuangui, was a native of Kuaiji in Yuezhou.

sentences.zh: 中進士第，補趙州司理參軍。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was appointed judicial assistant at Zhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the jinshi examination, he was appointed judicial assistant at Zhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 跌蕩自放，不守士節，然材猛過人。

translations.literal: Unrestrained and self-indulgent, he did not observe a scholar's propriety, yet his talent and boldness exceeded ordinary men.
translations.idiomatic: He was unrestrained and self-indulgent, heedless of a scholar's propriety, yet his talent and boldness exceeded ordinary men.

sentences.zh: 後以秘書丞為監察御史裏行。

translations.literal: Later, as Secretariat assistant director, he served as probationary supervising censor.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as Secretariat assistant director, he served as probationary supervising censor.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年，禮院奏用冬至日冊后，沔奏：「喪未祥禫而行嘉禮，非制也。」

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingyou, the Board of Rites memorialized to use the winter solstice for empress investiture. Mian memorialized: "To carry out an auspicious ceremony before mourning has reached the xiang and tan stages is contrary to regulation."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Jingyou (1034), the Board of Rites memorialized to use the winter solstice for empress investiture. Mian memorialized, "To carry out an auspicious ceremony before mourning has reached the xiang and tan stages is contrary to regulation."

sentences.zh: 同安縣尉李安世上書指切朝政，被劾，沔奏：「加罪安世，恐杜天下言者，請勿治。」

translations.literal: Li Anshi, lieutenant of Tong'an County, submitted a memorial sharply criticizing court affairs and was impeached. Mian memorialized: "If Anshi is punished more severely, I fear all who would speak under Heaven will be silenced. Please do not prosecute him."
translations.idiomatic: Li Anshi, lieutenant of Tong'an County, submitted a memorial sharply criticizing court affairs and was impeached. Mian memorialized, "If Anshi is punished more severely, I fear everyone under Heaven who would speak out will be silenced. Please do not prosecute him."

sentences.zh: 黜知衡山縣。

translations.literal: He was dismissed and made magistrate of Hengshan County.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed and made magistrate of Hengshan County.

sentences.zh: 道上書言時事，再貶永州監酒。

translations.literal: On the road he submitted another memorial on current affairs and was again demoted to wine supervisor at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the road he submitted another memorial on current affairs and was again demoted to wine supervisor at Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 移通判潭州、知處州。

translations.literal: He was transferred as vice-prefect of Tanzhou and made prefect of Chuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred as vice-prefect of Tanzhou and made prefect of Chuzhou.

sentences.zh: 復為監察御史，再知楚州。

translations.literal: He again became supervising censor and once more served as prefect of Chu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He again became supervising censor and once more served as prefect of Chu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 所在皆著能跡。

translations.literal: Wherever he served he left records of effective performance.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he served he left a record of effective performance.

sentences.zh: 召為左正言，論事益有直名。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Left Remonstrator, and in discussing affairs he gained an ever more forthright reputation.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as left remonstrator, and in discussing affairs he gained an ever more forthright reputation.

sentences.zh: 遷尚書工部員外郎，提舉兩浙刑獄，遂以起居舍人為陝西轉運使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Works, made judicial intendant of the Two Zhe circuits, and then, as diarist, became transport commissioner of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of Works, made judicial intendant of the Two Zhe circuits, and then, as diarist, became transport commissioner of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 時宰相呂夷簡求罷，仁宗優詔弗許。

translations.literal: At the time Chancellor Lü Yijian requested dismissal; Emperor Renzong with a gracious edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Chancellor Lü Yijian asked to retire; Emperor Renzong issued a gracious edict refusing to allow it.

sentences.zh: 沔上書言：「自夷簡當國，黜忠言，廢直道，及以使相出鎮許昌，乃薦王隨、陳堯叟代己。

translations.literal: Mian submitted a memorial saying: "Since Yijian took charge of the state, loyal words were dismissed and the straight path abandoned; when he left as envoy-minister to guard Xuchang, he recommended Wang Sui and Chen Yaosou to replace himself.
translations.idiomatic: Mian submitted a memorial saying, "Since Yijian took charge of the state, loyal words were dismissed and the straight path abandoned; when he left as envoy-minister to guard Xuchang, he recommended Wang Sui and Chen Yaosou to replace himself.

sentences.zh: 才庸負重，謀議不協，忿爭中堂，取笑多士，政事寢廢。

translations.literal: Mediocre in talent yet burdened with weighty office, their counsels did not agree, they quarreled angrily in the central hall, became laughingstocks among scholars, and state affairs gradually fell idle.
translations.idiomatic: Mediocre in talent yet burdened with weighty office, their counsels did not agree; they quarreled angrily in the central hall, became laughingstocks among scholars, and state affairs gradually ground to a halt.

sentences.zh: 又以張士遜冠台席，士遜本乏遠識，至隳國事。

translations.literal: Zhang Shisun was also placed at the head of the Council secretariat; Shisun originally lacked far-sighted judgment, to the point of ruining state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Shisun was also placed at the head of the Council secretariat; Shisun originally lacked far-sighted judgment and went so far as to ruin state affairs.

sentences.zh: 蓋夷簡不進賢為社稷遠圖，但引不若己者為自固之計，欲使陛下知輔相之位非己不可，冀復思己而召用也。

translations.literal: The reason is Yijian did not advance the worthy for the state's long-term plan, but only brought in men inferior to himself as a scheme of self-consolidation, wishing to make Your Majesty know the post of chancellor could not be filled without him, hoping You would again think of him and recall him to office.
translations.idiomatic: The reason is that Yijian did not advance the worthy for the state's long-term good, but only brought in men inferior to himself to consolidate his own position, wishing to make Your Majesty believe the post of chancellor could not be filled without him, in the hope that You would again think of him and recall him to office.

sentences.zh: 陛下果召夷簡還，自大名入秉朝政，於茲三年，不更一事。

translations.literal: Your Majesty did indeed recall Yijian; from Daming he re-entered to hold court power; in these three years since, not one thing has been changed.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty did indeed recall Yijian; from Daming he returned to hold court power, and in the three years since, not one thing has been changed.

sentences.zh: 以姑息為安，以避謗為智。

translations.literal: Taking indulgence as peace, taking avoidance of censure as wisdom.
translations.idiomatic: He takes indulgence for peace and avoidance of censure for wisdom.

sentences.zh: 西州將帥累以敗聞，契丹無厭，乘此求賂。

translations.literal: Western frontier generals repeatedly reported defeats; the Khitan, insatiable, seized this opportunity to demand bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Western frontier generals repeatedly reported defeats; the Khitan, never satisfied, seized the opportunity to demand bribes.

sentences.zh: 兵殲貨悖，天下空竭，刺史牧守，十不得一。

translations.literal: Armies were destroyed and goods depleted; the realm was emptied and exhausted; of prefects and governors, not one in ten was competent.
translations.idiomatic: Armies were destroyed and goods depleted; the realm was emptied and exhausted; of prefects and governors, scarcely one in ten was competent.

sentences.zh: 法令變易，士民怨嗟，隆盛之基，忽至於此。

translations.literal: Laws and orders changed back and forth; scholars and people lamented; the foundation of prosperity suddenly came to this.
translations.idiomatic: Laws and orders shifted back and forth; scholars and common people lamented; the foundation of prosperity had suddenly come to this.

sentences.zh: 今夷簡以病求退，陛下手和御藥，親寫德音，乃謂『恨不移卿之疾在於朕躬』，四方義士傳聞詔語，有泣下者。

translations.literal: Now Yijian requests retirement on grounds of illness; Your Majesty personally blended imperial medicine and wrote gracious words, even saying 'I regret that your illness cannot be transferred to my own body'; when principled men throughout the realm heard the edict's words, some wept.
translations.idiomatic: Now Yijian asks to retire on grounds of illness; Your Majesty personally blended imperial medicine and wrote gracious words, even saying, 'I regret that your illness cannot be transferred to my own body'; when principled men throughout the realm heard the edict, some wept.

sentences.zh: 夷簡在中書二十年，三冠輔相，所言無不聽，所請無不行，有宋得君，一人而已，未知何以為陛下報？

translations.literal: Yijian has been in the Secretariat twenty years and three times stood as chief minister; whatever he said was heard, whatever he requested was granted — in all the Song dynasty, only one man has ever won such favor from his sovereign; who knows with what he will repay Your Majesty?
translations.idiomatic: Yijian has been in the Secretariat for twenty years and three times stood as chief minister; whatever he said was heard and whatever he requested was granted — in all the Song dynasty, only one man has ever won such favor from his sovereign; who knows how he will repay Your Majesty?

sentences.zh: 天下皆稱賢而陛下不用者，左右毀之也；

translations.literal: Those the realm all calls worthy yet Your Majesty does not employ — it is because those at your side slander them;
translations.idiomatic: Those whom the realm calls worthy yet Your Majesty does not employ — it is because those at your side slander them;

sentences.zh: 皆謂憸邪而陛下不知者，朋黨蔽之也。

translations.literal: those all called corrupt yet Your Majesty does not recognize — it is because factions conceal them.
translations.idiomatic: those whom all call corrupt yet Your Majesty does not recognize — it is because factions conceal them.

sentences.zh: 比契丹復盟，西夏款塞，公卿忻忻，日望和平。

translations.literal: Recently the Khitan renewed the alliance and Western Xia showed goodwill at the border; ministers rejoice daily, looking toward peace.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the Khitan renewed the alliance and Western Xia showed goodwill at the border; the ministers rejoice daily and look toward peace.

sentences.zh: 若因此振紀綱，修廢墜，選賢任能，節用養兵，則景德、祥符之風，復見於今矣。

translations.literal: If from this you revive discipline, restore what has fallen into ruin, select the worthy and employ the capable, economize and nourish the armies — then the spirit of the Jingde and Xianfu eras would again appear in our day.
translations.idiomatic: If from this you revive discipline, restore what has fallen into ruin, select the worthy and employ the capable, economize and nourish the armies, then the spirit of the Jingde and Xianfu eras would again appear in our day.

sentences.zh: 若恬然不顧，遂以為安，臣恐土崩瓦解，不可復救。

translations.literal: If you remain indifferent and take this for peace, your servant fears the realm will crumble and cannot again be rescued.
translations.idiomatic: If you remain indifferent and take this for peace, your servant fears the realm will crumble beyond rescue.

sentences.zh: 而夷簡意謂四方已寧，百度已正，欲因病默默而去，無一言啟沃上心，別白賢不肖，雖盡南山之竹，不足書其罪也。」

translations.literal: Yet Yijian's thought is that the four quarters are already pacified and all affairs already put right; he wishes to depart silently on grounds of illness, with not a word to nourish Your Majesty's mind or distinguish worthy from unworthy — even if you used all the bamboo on Nanshan, it would not suffice to record his crimes."
translations.idiomatic: Yet Yijian believes the four quarters are already pacified and all affairs already put right; he wishes to depart silently on grounds of illness, without a word to nourish Your Majesty's mind or distinguish worthy from unworthy — even if you used all the bamboo on Nanshan, it would not suffice to record his crimes."

sentences.zh: 書聞，帝不之罪，議者喜其謇切。

translations.literal: When the memorial was received, the Emperor did not punish him; commentators rejoiced at his forthright bluntness.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial was received, the Emperor did not punish him; commentators rejoiced at his forthright candor.

sentences.zh: 居兩月，以天章閣待制為都轉運使，又遷禮部郎中，為環慶路都總管、安撫經略使、知慶州。

translations.literal: After two months, he was made Hanlin attendant as grand transport commissioner; further promoted to director of the Rites Bureau; made grand commander of Huanqing Circuit, pacification and frontier commissioner, and prefect of Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After two months, he was made Hanlin attendant and grand transport commissioner; he was further promoted to director of the Rites Bureau and appointed grand commander of Huanqing Circuit, pacification and frontier commissioner, and prefect of Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元昊死，諸將欲乘其隙，大舉滅之。

translations.literal: When Yuanhao died, generals wished to seize the opportunity and launch a major campaign to destroy them.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanhao died, the generals wished to seize the opportunity and launch a major campaign to destroy the Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 沔曰：「乘危伐喪，非中國體。」
